title: SECTION-8 CLOSE AT THE AUDIT BAND MACHINE-VERIFIED: QSide Part E (mPin = 1/112.6 the C4 margin pin, mPin_lt_half, section8_close_at_audit) proves the closure's contradiction instantiates at the day-020 pins - no real X with the C2 lower bound dev*(1-mPin) AND the C3 margin bound dev/112.6; full build 17450 green
body: THE MOVE: QSide.lean Part E names and gates the SECTION-8 CLOSURE (outline section-8, spec closure-module-abstract.md) INSTANTIATED AT THE DAY-020 AUDIT-BAND PINS - the machine check that the closure's margin hypothesis actually CLOSES at the measured constants (a data gate in the program's honesty pattern).  THE ROLE MAPPING (fixed against the spec in this entry; the walk-spine letters are the P1.2 encoding of section-8): the zero-side scale Q (the walk's hs1 leg) IS the resid = |zeta(1/2+it) - K_on(t)| fill (the QSide face, Part D); the deviation dev = f(delta, t) * |K(t)|, the kernel change at the pair's own height (the detector, C1/C1b floor 0.9975 on the audited window); the C4 margin pin m := 1/112.6 is the day-020 worst-case audit constant (margin = dev/resid, overall worst 112.6 at the closing point t = 1006.7916) - it enters the squeeze as the upper bound on the tail error M (C4: M(G, t) <= m * dev) and as the <-side bound (the audit pins the fill X = resid <= dev/112.6 = dev*m at the closing point).  THE NEW CONSTANTS/FACTS (QSide.lean Part E, all LEAN-PROVEN): mPin : R := 1/112.6 (def); mPin_lt_half : mPin < 1/2 (norm_num - the 112.6x audit is what makes the gap real: 1 - mPin > mPin); section8_close_at_audit : NOT (exists X, X >= devWorst * (1 - mPin) AND X <= devWorst / marginWorst) - THE THEOREM: there is no real X satisfying simultaneously (a) the C2 >= side at its WEAKEST (worst-case M = m*dev pushes the lower bound down to dev*(1 - m) = 9.198 * (111.6/112.6) = 9.1163...) and (b) the C3/C4 < side AT THE PIN (the measured fill X <= dev/112.6 = 0.081687...); the proof: devWorst/marginWorst = devWorst*mPin (field_simp), the gap devWorst*mPin < devWorst*(1 - mPin) (norm_num on the pins - pure rational arithmetic), then X >= dev*(1-mPin) and X <= dev*mPin with dev*mPin < dev*(1-mPin) forces False (nlinarith).  STATUS OF THE PARTS: the >= side (C2) is the LEAN-PROVEN composition in the tree (A0 identity + A1 triangle + A2b.1 + A4.3, under the mass premise |x| <= Xval - the Xval pin is gated in Part B/C with the 206x headroom); the < side AT THE PIN and the m pin are the MEASURED/PINNED data of the day-020 record (gated in Parts B/C); the CONTRADICTION STEP itself is the engine (C5 = p9_point_contradiction, cross-checked standalone in ProbeMargin6, discovery 0089).  So Part E is the GATE on the data: it verifies, by machine, that the audited pins make the two sides of section-8 arithmetically incompatible at the closing point - if the measured margin were ever <= 2 (m >= 1/2), mPin_lt_half would fail and the gate would flag the band.  PER SPEC SEC 3 (honesty boundary): the margin is the audited-window pin, NOT promoted to a universal forall-t claim (Route-A instrument boundary t ~ 1e4-2e4); the uniform extension of the face is the documented open item (the S1 height-uniformity measurement track, P1.2 spec S1: the P1.1e margin regime from ~5.6e7 upward is MEASURED, sub-1 the asymptotic regime of the P1.1e wire).  NO RH claim: this is the gate arithmetic of the closure's margin hypothesis at the day-020 constants; the endpoint (RHEnd.rh_program78) still names its four residual legs (hs1, hs3, hWin, hS2low).  FULL TREE BUILD GREEN 17450.  ALSO (data, in flight): s31z2 5e8G ladder - dps-15 logzeta = +2.9370199551 and dps-20 logzeta = +1.7289704098 LANDED (peaks 92.6 GB); dps-30 in flight (~52 min of ~75); dps-40 (the census channel) last.
